rows.label: qst200213_msg0001
rows.name:
So, a girl named Harhal hired me
to gather three kinds of medicinal
herbs, mo.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0002
rows.name: Harhal, you say!?

rows.label: qst200213_msg0003
rows.name:
But, what will those
herbs be used for?

rows.label: qst200213_msg0004
rows.name:
The herbs make Pollen Orbs that double
your stamina and energy, mo!

rows.label: qst200213_msg0005
rows.name: Those Pollen Orbs Nopon love, huh.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0006
rows.name:
Though they are prohibited
in some countries.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0007
rows.name: Eh? Is that so?

rows.label: qst200213_msg0008
rows.name:
Pollen Orbs are highly addictive,
and if used too much, they
cause harm to the body.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0009
rows.name:
So imports and exports should be
completely banned in Superbia, right?

rows.label: qst200213_msg0010
rows.name: That's exactly right, mo.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0011
rows.name:
Harhal knows they're banned,
but she'll pay a high price, mo.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0012
rows.name: I see. Thanks for telling us, Jaruru.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0013
rows.name:
Your fiery eyes moved me, mo.
I'll never take a bad job again, mo!

rows.label: qst200213_msg0014
rows.name:
So where was the deal supposed to be?
Harhal will be there too, right?

rows.label: qst200213_msg0015
rows.name: I don't know where Harhal is now, mo.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0016
rows.name:
I was going to hide the herbs among
other cargo and have a sailor at
Port Ananyam carry them, mo.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0017
rows.name:
Port Ananyam[ML:Dash ] What is
that sailor's name?

rows.label: qst200213_msg0018
rows.name: His name is Tuvarri, mo.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0019
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Anger ]Uooooh!
Tuvarri, you'd better be ready!!

rows.label: qst200213_msg0101
rows.name:
Look at my eyes! These
are the eyes of justice!

rows.label: qst200213_msg0102
rows.name:
Look me in the eye and be honest.
Have you done anything
you feel guilty about?!

rows.label: qst200213_msg0103
rows.name:
N-no...
Nothing to feel guilty about[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200213_msg0104
rows.name:
Really? Can you swear that
to yourself?!

rows.label: qst200213_msg0105
rows.name: Uuu[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200213_msg0106
rows.name:
If there's something you feel
guilty about, tell me everything.

rows.label: qst200213_msg0107
rows.name:
No matter what happens, I won't
abandon you. I will save you!

rows.label: qst200213_msg0108
rows.name:
U-uuuh[ML:Dash ]
Okay, mo~

rows.label: qst200213_msg0109
rows.name: Jaruru will tell everything, mo~
